name: speaker-notes
body: A `# notes` section holds speaker notes, rendered via the embedded reveal.js notes plugin (`dist/plugin/notes.js`), and is allowed only on slides (a slide file's top level), never inside a section template (= error). At most one `# notes` section per slide, and it must be the last section on the slide; a second `# notes` = error, and a `# notes` followed by any other section = error. It does not count toward any section's min/max repeat limits. `notes` is reserved and cannot be declared as a template section name. Notes body follows the Markdown subset.
